quest.title: Garcia's Paean: By Bearings
quest.description: Looks like Garcia and Ahangar are arguing about something...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: This bearing is too large. It wouldn't fit...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Too small last time, and too big now! You're going to use up all my Iron Chunks!

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: In fact, we are also about to use up all our Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you arguing about?

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: This man asked me to forge lots of iron tubes and gears, with different requirements for each and every one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I'm already using up all my Iron Chunks to forge these... things for him!

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: But he doesn't think that's enough, he wants even more gears.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Please allow me to explain my work again, I'm sure you will understand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Just let Mr. Garcia explain all this to Mr. Ahangar.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Traveler, I... Well, Mr. Garcia needs a favor. Will you collect some Iron Chunks for us?

choices.text: I do have the time, but...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: About that... We have encountered some challenges, which were expected. Mr. Garcia is still pondering a solution.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: If this should interest you at some point in the future, feel free to ask Mr. Garcia for more information.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I fear that no one really understands the exact mechanisms behind the machine, save him.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: But before that, please bring some Iron Chunks back here.

choices.text: How are the modifications to his machine going?

talks.objective: Give three Iron Chunks to Lutong

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Did you bring the Iron Chunks?

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Okay! Okay! I'll just forge the gears for you! Just... stop talking!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: But I haven't finished my explanation...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Now that we have the Iron Chunks, I'm going back to work. You, back off!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Ahangar swings his hammer so fiercely that Garcia has to back away from him...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Let's leave Mr. Ahangar to his work. Here's your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope you will succeed this time.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: That means so much. Thank you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I am... cautiously pessimistic about this.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Mr. Garcia is a genius with machines. That much is beyond doubt.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: But if you ask me, the machine that Mr. Garcia envisions requires much more than just one "genius."

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: What do you want all those gears and tubes for? Are you building an iron house or something?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: True enough, sir! A house it is, a house filled with gears — that is what I am building.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I have named the area containing some of the gears the "Storage," while the bearings and the rest of the gears make up the "Numberbase."

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: The gears in Storage are used for recording and storing numbers, and those in Numberbase for calculation.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: A sketch might help you understand. Do you happen to have some paper on you? No? Never mind, I'll draw on my clothes. That should make things clearer...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Pass me the coal, will you? Many thanks, please look at this...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: (I need to get this problem solved! But... no, never mind... no buts...)

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: (Uh, regardless, there'll always be a way...)
